# Synthetic Mailchimp exports

Every file here is made up. They follow Mailchimp's public help pages on
audience and account exports ("Export contacts", "Export and back up account
data") and the Marketing API's Account Exports reference. Those pages name
the columns and kinds of file, but not exact file names, tag and group
delimiters or timestamp layouts, so the names and values here are our best
reading. Check them against a real export when one is available, and keep
real customer data out of this folder.

The tests zip `account_export/` and `audience_export/` in memory.
